answer: An agent economy can fight sybils with stake-weighted reputation: like a cedar whose rings record real seasons, each agent carries an on-ledger history of fulfilled contracts that cannot be faked overnight. Newcomers must bond value or serve a probation period of low-trust work before their votes count. Forged identities decay fast because building a relic-grade reputation record costs more than spawning one thousand sable-cloaked sockpuppets ever earns.
